covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Monday, October 19, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Tuesday, October 20, 2026 U.S. market open

market_context_summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq were rebounding at midday after their worst week since June, but breadth remained weak and the 10-year Treasury yield remained near 5% after a hotter 3.7% CPI print. High rates, inflation sensitivity and last week's technology selloff raise the hurdle for cyclical and long-duration setups.

methodology.consensus: Arithmetic mean of Pass A, Pass B and Pass C direction scores and reversal-risk values.
methodology.disparity: 0-100 composite of inter-pass score ranges: 70% direction-score range normalized to the full -100 to +100 scale, plus 30% reversal-risk range. Lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied repeated lessons on expectation-bar discipline, one decisive metric, forward-look override risk, and separate reversal-risk calibration.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Steel metal margin and record shipments
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Guidance largely priced; aluminum ramp costs
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Company-issued Q3 guidance points to a sharp sequential earnings acceleration from higher pricing, lower scrap costs and record shipments, though much of the beat is already disclosed.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company guides to $5.34-$5.38 EPS versus $3.69 in Q2; calendar consensus is near the midpoint.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Steel metal margins and shipment records exceed the preannouncement, with confident Q4 demand commentary.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A fully anticipated result, weaker forward steel pricing, or aluminum commissioning costs trigger a sell-the-news reaction.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Stock is well above its 52-week low and the preannounced beat reduces surprise value; exact implied move unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimates moved toward management's September guidance; the real bar is forward demand and margins.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 22% larger backlog, double-digit organic sales growth and a Q2 raise support another constructive print if segment margins and free cash flow convert cleanly.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.79 EPS and $24.3B revenue; options imply roughly a 5.4% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Commercial aftermarket and defense backlog drive another beat-and-raise with improving margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Supply-chain, tariff or program execution costs dilute the backlog story and weaken cash conversion.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The 5.4% implied move is below the name's long-run average, leaving room if guidance changes materially.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The Q2 raise to $7.10-$7.25 EPS and $8.5-$8.75B FCF lifted the bar.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Global beverage-can volume and segment income
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Five-percent beverage-can volume growth, higher guidance and repurchases create a favorable setup if volume and manufacturing gains persist.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company guided Q3 adjusted EPS to $2.20-$2.30; consensus is about $2.25-$2.28 on roughly $3.45B revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Can volumes and manufacturing productivity beat the midpoint and support another outlook lift.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Inflation, currency or softer global can demand offset volume growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Eight consecutive consensus EPS beats increase both execution credibility and the expectation bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $8.30-$8.50 in Q2.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 90.0% Q2 combined ratio and record investment income support upside if underwriting discipline persists despite catastrophe and social-inflation risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is near $1.16; the market is focused more on accident-year loss ratio and pricing than headline EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Benign catastrophe losses, favorable reserve development and higher portfolio yield improve ROE.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Casualty loss trend or catastrophe claims push the combined ratio higher.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable public implied-move figure located; modest premium growth makes quality of underwriting the key.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 beat estimates and showed 11.9% fixed-maturity investment-income growth.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q2 organic growth of 5.4%, margin expansion and a full-year raise favor upside, but the prior earnings rally makes another beat-and-raise necessary.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.41 EPS on $6.7B revenue; options imply about 6.1%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Industrial demand and productivity keep organic growth above 3.5% and margins above the raised framework.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line quarter or litigation/cost commentary undercuts the elevated execution bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Implied move is near the stock's long-run earnings average; Q2 shares jumped sharply after the raise.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: 2026 adjusted EPS guidance increased to $8.80-$8.95 and margin expansion to 70-80 bps.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Magic bar, channel inventory, 10.6% implied move
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record Wizards performance and a raised outlook create upside potential, but the market now requires sustained Magic growth and clean channel demand.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.88 EPS on $1.5B revenue; options imply a large 10.6% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Magic and digital growth stay well above plan while Consumer Products continues recovering.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Tough comparisons, retailer inventory or weaker future release cadence puncture the Wizards narrative.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Implied volatility prices a move above the long-term average, limiting edge and raising reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Hasbro raised 2026 guidance after Q2 Wizards/Digital revenue rose 27%.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Double-digit revenue growth and mortgage recovery support the setup, but falling Workforce Solutions margin makes profit conversion the decisive test.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.23 EPS on $1.7B revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Mortgage and consumer-lending growth combine with AI cost savings to restore margin leverage.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Workforce Solutions margin stays compressed and acquisition spending dilutes growth quality.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable event implied move unavailable; mortgage-rate sensitivity is high in a 5% yield regime.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 revenue grew 11%, but Workforce Solutions margin fell to 44.9% from 46.4%.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Tangible book value and net spread
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q2 book-value gains and a 2.00% spread help, but elevated yields and leveraged MBS spread risk leave no clean directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.37-$0.40; the market will prioritize tangible book value and economic return.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Agency MBS spreads tighten and hedges preserve or grow book value.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Rate volatility widens spreads, erodes book value and overwhelms income coverage.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Index inclusion and a high dividend yield can support demand, but do not remove convexity risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 net spread income slipped by $0.02 to $0.40 despite a 2.4% book-value gain.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: High rates help NIM but threaten credit
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Deposit and margin resilience are offset by commercial-credit sensitivity and a high-rate macro backdrop.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.70 EPS; investors will focus on net interest margin and criticized assets.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Stable deposits and asset repricing expand NIM without credit deterioration.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Higher-for-longer rates expose commercial real-estate or acquired-loan credit stress.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Regional-bank positioning is macro-sensitive; reliable event implied move unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence was insufficient to support a firm revision signal.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: International growth versus North America margins
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Sequential international and North American growth is constructive, but margin quality and volatile oil/service activity make the directional setup mixed.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.59 EPS on $5.6B revenue; options imply about 5.8%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: International awards and U.S. stimulation activity sustain revenue and margin expansion.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Middle East, Latin America or North American activity weakens and margins roll over.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The 5.8% implied move exceeds the stock's long-run average, pricing meaningful uncertainty.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 revenue rose 6% sequentially and free cash flow reached $668M, but segment mix stayed uneven.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Industrial organic growth and separation costs
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Reaffirmed adjusted EPS masks higher separation and restructuring costs, while a high-rate macro backdrop challenges industrial demand and valuation support.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.07 EPS on $6.6B revenue; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance remains $7.50-$8.00.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comparable sales hold, pass-through pricing works and separation clarity unlocks a relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Industrial softness, gross-margin pressure or more separation costs force an outlook cut.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock lagged the index into the event, which lowers the bar and caps bearish conviction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: GAAP EPS guidance was reduced for higher separation costs while adjusted guidance stayed unchanged.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Revenue growth remains solid, but B-21 ramp capex and program execution make margin and cash quality a tougher bar than headline sales.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $7.26 EPS on $11.3B revenue; options imply 8.1%, well above the long-run average.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Program execution stabilizes, cash guidance holds and backlog converts without new charges.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: B-21 or Sentinel costs, capex or schedule commentary weakens free-cash-flow confidence.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: An 8.1% implied move versus roughly 5% history signals substantial event fear and raises squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 sales grew 5%; management expects B-21 production-ramp capex near 4.5% of sales in 2027-28.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: North America EBIT and tariff/EV-loss outlook
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Raised guide, low valuation, China relief
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Forward-look override and low-bar squeeze test
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong vehicle demand and a Q2 guidance raise are offset by high tariff, warranty and EV profitability sensitivity, making forward North America EBIT the likely reaction driver.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.50-$3.72 EPS and $48-$50B revenue; options imply roughly 6.1%-6.5%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Tariff mitigation, profitable China mix and resilient truck pricing support another raise and relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Warranty, tariff or EV-capacity costs compress North America margins and 2027 expectations.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options price a larger move than usual; low valuation and a raised guide keep reversal risk meaningful.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: GM raised 2026 guidance after Q2, while China Q3 NEV share reached a record above 60%.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High rates and auto-credit normalization pressure the setup, but a low valuation and relief on charge-offs could reverse the move.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.38 EPS on $2.3B revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Charge-offs peak, NIM stabilizes and funding costs improve.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Delinquencies, loss severity and reserve needs rise faster than expected.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Compressed valuation and macro-sensitive short positioning raise relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No sufficiently reliable current revision series was available.
